component.name: TaskB
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "runTask" m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("check", m.port) end sub
sub runTask() m.top.ready = true for i = 0 to 200 msg = wait(50, m.port) if type(msg) = "roSGNodeEvent" and msg.getField() = "check" and msg.getData() value = m.global.marker if value = invalid m.top.resultValue = "INVALID" else m.top.resultValue = value end if return end if end for m.top.resultValue = "TIMEOUT" end sub
